relationships.subject: leptin
relationships.evidence_quote: Leptin, secreted by adipocytes, facilitates inhibitory transmission from fast-spiking interneurons to pyramidal neurons via the presynaptic JAK2-PI3K-Akt signaling pathway.

relationships.subject: insulin
relationships.evidence_quote: insulin increases GABA release from fast spiking interneurons to pyramidal neurons in a PI3K-Akt-dependent manner

key_findings: Orexin, leptin and insulin each facilitate inhibitory transmission in the insular cortex via distinct intracellular pathways (PLC/IP3, JAK2-PI3K-Akt, PI3K-Akt).
